item.title: Federal government failed to hold Epstein accountable, Republican committee says
item.description: The Republican chair of the House Oversight Committee released a scathing report after a 15-month investigation into Jeffrey Epstein and his associates. It faulted the federal government with decades of failing to hold Epstein accountable.
item.content:encoded:
The Republican chair of the House Oversight Committee released a scathing report after a 15-month investigation into Jeffrey Epstein and his associates. It faulted the federal government with decades of failing to hold Epstein accountable.

(Image credit: Jose Luis Magana)

item.title: House votes to effectively end the impeachment effort against Pete Hegseth
item.description: House Republicans managed to short-circuit a floor vote on the impeachment effort brought against the Defense Secretary by Kentucky Republican Thomas Massie.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Supreme Court seems split over federal agencies' ability to fine for law violations
item.description: The Supreme Court heard arguments Tuesday in a case related to temporary worker visas. The company involved says enforcement issues should go through the courts, not the federal agency alone.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Russia's most famous independent newspaper has shut down after more than 30 years
item.description: Russia's top independent newspaper is closing after more than 30 years amid state pressure and censorship laws. Its founder won the Nobel Peace Prize and several of its journalists have been killed.
item.content:encoded: Russia's top independent newspaper is closing after more than 30 years amid state pressure and censorship laws. Its founder won the Nobel Peace Prize and several of its journalists have been killed.

item.title: Tattoo artists are carrying Rembrandt's art into a new era — and a new medium
item.description: The Rembrandt House Museum in Amsterdam hosted an unusual exhibit in recent weeks — a renowned tattoo artist inking the Dutch master's designs on visitors' skin.

item.title: Testing the new generation of AI-enabled fire-extinguishing drones
item.description: Drone makers are testing new, big drones that can deliver water or fire retardant with AI assistance. Aspen, Colorado is the first place trying them out. Cool and expensive? Yes. Effective? TBD.

item.title: Americans across the economic spectrum feel a 'panic' about finances, author says
item.description: Mona Chalabi spent five years following Americans living paycheck to paycheck, as well as those earning top wages. Her new book, Ten Lives, explores why financial security can feel so elusive.

item.description: Gasoline prices fell below $4 a gallon Tuesday for the first time in three months — but the overall cost of living remains stubbornly high.
